[COURSEWORK / PROJECT SUMMARY]{.eyebrow}

## The question

How can a structured query turn a business question into a reproducible answer?

## Approach

Coursework practice with selecting, filtering, grouping, and summarizing relational data. The portfolio communicates query logic alongside outputs so a reader can follow the reasoning.

## What this work demonstrates

SQL helps define the unit of analysis and the conditions behind a result. An aggregate answers a specific question only when its filters and grouping match that question.
